hypotheses.bars: closed 15m; execution no earlier than next 1m open
hypotheses.regime: 4h close above rising EMA200 (slope over prior 8 4h-bars > 0) for LONG, mirrored for SHORT; confirmed by 1h ADX(14) >= 20, both reindexed from fully-closed higher-timeframe bars only
hypotheses.trigger: RSI(2) <= 10 AND Connors RSI(3,2,100) <= 15 both true on the same closed 15m bar, evaluated as 'fired within this bar or either of the previous two' (a 3-bar recency window) for LONG; mirrored (>=90 / >=85) for SHORT. The climax bar and the eventual reaction bar are not required to be identical.
hypotheses.risk: stop = rolling 5-bar low (long) / high (short) including the trigger bar, minus/plus 0.15 ATR buffer; actual-fill stop width clamped 0.50-2.00 ATR
hypotheses.exit: breakeven-then-chandelier trailing: stop moves to breakeven+round-trip cost once price reaches +1.0R, then trails at best-price minus 1.5x ATR (ATR frozen at entry); 5.0R hard cap; 240 minute time stop

hypotheses.trigger: identical to H1, PLUS: within the same 3-bar recency window, the low (long) / high (short) must have swept below/above the rolling extreme of the PRIOR 20 closed bars (excluding the trigger bar itself), and the CURRENT bar must close back on the correct side of that level with a directional body (SMC stop-hunt-then-reclaim, causally approximated with no live order-book/DB dependency). The sweep and the reclaim are not required to be the identical bar; the reclaim confirmation itself must be on the current (signal) bar.

symbols.note: No BTC reference series is used by this strategy; regime and trigger are computed entirely from each traded symbol's own price.

windows.warmup_rationale: 4h EMA200 needs ~33 days of 4h bars just to produce its first value; 4 months of warmup lets it converge before development starts, instead of trading on a freshly-initialized average.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.trailing_mechanics: breakeven+chandelier trailing added to backend/backtest/cluster_scalp_simulator.py (config.trailing), gated to require partial_fraction=0 since the cluster engine does not reduce position size on partial exits, only gates trailing activation
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2 central configurations. No parameter grid over RSI/CRSI thresholds, ADX threshold, or sweep lookback. A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner. Simultaneous candidates use fixed liquidity priority ETH, then SOL, then BNB.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink. A smaller severe loss is not evidence of robustness.
known_limitations: ATR used for the chandelier trail is frozen at entry (the shared cluster simulator carries no per-symbol ATR series to refresh it bar-by-bar); this is a conservative simplification, not a bug fix pending.
The liquidity-sweep proxy in H2 is a rolling OHLC extreme, not a reconstruction of real resting order-book liquidity, PDH/PDL, or equal-highs/lows clustering.
This is a retrospective diagnostic over previously-unseen (for this specific strategy) but historically-public data; it is not a live paper-forward result.
